theorems.name: Submission.tangentMeasure_lipschitz_cover_of_projection_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Rn N)) (E : Set (Rn N)) (C δ : ℝ), finrank ℝ Q = n → 0 < δ → (∀ x ∈ E, ∀ y ∈ E, ‖y - x‖ < δ → ‖y - x‖ ≤ C * ‖Q.starProjection (y - x)‖) → ∃ F : ℕ → Rn n → Rn N, (∀ i, ∃ K : ℝ≥0, LipschitzWith K (F i)) ∧ E ⊆ ⋃ i, Set.range (F i)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
